content:
Application of pulsed magneto-hydrodynamic MHD generators in EM surveying was introduced in the 1970s by Russian physicist Evgeny Velikhov. First application of an MHD generator for EM soundings was performed during the Khibini experiment, in the 1980s in the USSR. #uapx

The Khibini experiment was one of the first large-scale experiments of deep EM sounding using high-power pulses. It provided geophysicists with a unique opportunity to test new technologies for studying a deep-earth interior using a controlled-source EM field. 

This part was about the civilian use of MHD generators, as always, there is a secret, far more malicious side that can be used for military purposes. This test is somehow connected to the sighting of mushroom clouds on the coast of Japan and over the Kola Peninsula without a nuclear explosion. Because of the earthquake, Norway thought that the Russians were conducting underground nuclear tests.  

There are civilian versions of this test published by research institutes but in 2024 i found one post from Russian portal that gives different insight of these tests that were conducted in this time frame 1970-1990s.

This caught my attention because the CIA declassified documents on Soviet scalar weaponry which, apparently, indicate the same timeframe and location as the test conducted by Evgeny Velikhov on the Kola Peninsula. There is also a declassified CIA file on remote viewing in which they saw, in their assessment, a T-shaped building, which is real and existed, and described something that uncanny resembles MHD generators.

It's pretty wild story but Russian psychist Evgheny Velikhov said himself everything they do in high energy physics can be turned into weapon.
